title: Zoning text change for 69-67 108th Street, Queens
summary: This application would amend the Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 69-67 108th Street in Forest Hills, Queens. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would facilitate an 11-story mixed-use building with about 59 apartments, including 15 income-restricted units, and 3,900 square feet of commercial space. The Council approved the measure with modifications on October 8, 2026.
